  Context
    `{Map_U_inst: Map U}

    `{Binddt_U_inst: Binddt W T U}
    `{! Compat_Map_Binddt W T U}

  Context
    `{ToSubset_T_inst: ToSubset T}

    `{! Compat_ToSubset_Traverse T}

  Context
    `{ToCtxset_T_inst: ToCtxset W T}

  Context
    `{Monad_inst: ! DecoratedTraversableMonad W T}
